title: Fixed-universe derived localizations and adjunction for open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] for structure-sheaf modules on $X$ and on every localized open site, all with morphism universe $w$. For any open $U$, there are derived localizations, in the same universe $w$, for modules on the open subscheme $U$ and on each of its localized open sites. There is also a right adjoint $R$ to the exact derived localized restriction $L=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_U)$, with an adjunction $L\dashv R$. These assertions hold without compactness or support hypotheses.

proof.text: Use the exact module equivalence Modules.overEquiv U and its induced derived equivalence to transport local w-smallness from the given localization on the localized site to the standard derived category of the open scheme. MorphismProperty.hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall supplies hD by shrinking Hom types.

Apply the proved [lem-pc-derived-open-localization-universe] to the open scheme with hD, obtaining the family hO of localizations on its localized open sites in the same universe w. This theorem uses exact extension by zero and restriction to transfer the Hom smallness.

The localized restriction L has its existing explicit underived right adjoint G. Use [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] to install the Grothendieck abelian structure on its target and the existing source-library K-injective resolution instance. Apply the proved upstream CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction to obtain L.mapDerivedCategory adjoint to G.rightDerivedFunctor. This API establishes the absolute-derived hypotheses and applies [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived].

theorem open_derived_localization_adjunction
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ∃ hD : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
    letI := hD
    ∃ hO : ∀ W : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over W)),
    letI := hO
    ∃ (R : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
        schemeDerivedCategory X),
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
